summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Guinea Land Hub new features: Market Trends dashboard, Land Comparison, Saved Searches with filters, and Local Language support (Pular, Maninka, Susu). All 23 backend tests passed. Fixed a bug in SavedSearches dialog where SelectItem had empty string values causing runtime error.
passed_tests: API root endpoint returns correct response
GET /api/market/trends returns market trends data with summary
POST /api/compare with 2 lands returns comparison with best_value
Frontend: Market Trends page loads with summary cards (Tendance, Transactions, Volume)
Frontend: Market Trends shows price chart with GNF/m² data
Frontend: Market Trends has 3 filter dropdowns (region, type, months)
Frontend: Land Comparison page loads with add land button
Frontend: Land Comparison selector modal shows available lands
Frontend: Land Comparison shows side-by-side comparison with best value badges
Frontend: Land Comparison shows metrics summary (price, size, price/m²)
Frontend: Login with admin credentials works
Frontend: Saved Searches page loads for authenticated users
Frontend: Saved Searches 'Nouvelle recherche' dialog opens without errors (FIXED)
Frontend: Language switcher shows Pular, Maninka, Susu options
Frontend: Pular language translations work (Jeyal Leyɗe e Gine)
Frontend: Maninka language translations work (Dugukolo Feere Gine)

bugs_fixed.issue: SelectItem components had value='' (empty string) which is not allowed in Radix UI Select
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed empty string values to 'all' and updated handleSaveSearch to convert 'all' back to empty string for API

critical_code_review_comments: Market Trends API correctly aggregates transaction data by month with price per m² calculations
Land Comparison API properly calculates best_value metrics (cheapest, largest, best_price_per_m2)
Saved Searches API correctly stores and retrieves user search filters
Local language translations (Pular, Maninka, Susu) are properly implemented in i18n.js
Language switcher in Navbar correctly shows all 5 language options
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_new_features_iter8.py - Created comprehensive test file for new features
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data - 7 lands, 2 transactions available
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features tested and working: 1) Market Trends at /market-trends shows price evolution by month with filters, 2) Land Comparison at /compare allows side-by-side comparison of up to 5 lands with best value indicators, 3) Saved Searches at /saved-searches allows authenticated users to save and execute search filters, 4) Local languages (Pular, Maninka, Susu) added to language switcher with translations. Fixed bug in SavedSearches dialog where SelectItem had empty string values. Admin login works with admin@guinealand.com/admin123.

market_trends.price_chart: Shows monthly avg price per m² with transaction count

features: Best value badges (Moins cher, Plus grand, Meilleur)

local_languages.language_switcher: Shows all 5 languages (FR, EN, Pular, Maninka, Susu)
